caseStudies.name: Smart Self-Improving Lines: scaling one fix to many lines, in parallel
caseStudies.learning: A pilot isn't a product until someone else can run it without you. Write the playbook while the knowledge is still fresh.

smart.specific: Take proven solutions for our most common losses from one line to many lines **in parallel**. Single-line fixes stay hard-coded and specific, so we bucketed the top losses into two scalable themes: **auto-centerline closed loop** and **equipment performance**.
smart.measurable: **8 common problems** (labellers, filling, capping, glue and more) that account for **38% of common failures**. Labellers alone scale to **20+ lines** at about **$500K per instance**; pilot and demo lines set the exact average value per instance before scale-up.
smart.achievable: Run a pilot and a demo line per problem, then capture the solution in a Common Best Approach (CBA) template for fast reapplication. An LLM agent, the AI Use-Case Finder, helps sites find the right use case and hands them the CBA: team charter, inputs and outputs, model artifacts.
smart.relevant: These are the biggest shared sources of loss across the network, so every reapplied solution compounds value instead of starting from zero.
smart.timeBound: Started in **June 2025 (FY26)**. All lead lines and CBAs are in place; next is parallel reapplication across lines and sites.

caseStudies.name: Anomaly detection: the foundation for unattended operations
caseStudies.learning: When failures are rare, stop waiting for labels. Teach the model what normal looks like and let it tell you when something isn't.

kpis.label: savings opened by the first project

smart.specific: Build an anomaly-detection portfolio as the foundation for **unattended operations**, so teams intervene at the right moment on problems such as nozzle degradation, motors and mills, and moulding, without needing labelled failure data.
smart.measurable: The first project detected a mill anomaly behind heavy scrap and opened **$5.8M** in savings. The portfolio now runs **15 use cases** on one standard approach, including moulding defects flagged within **24 hours** of deployment.
smart.achievable: Started the portfolio with several easy-to-use tools, including an off-the-shelf unsupervised app on Siemens Industrial Edge, to drive adoption with operators. I own the deployment approach and coach site teams, who build and run their own projects.
smart.relevant: Unplanned stops and scrap stand between today's lines and unattended operations; operators need early, trustworthy signals to act on.

caseStudies.name: AI-X: low-code MLOps from data-science laptop to factory machine
caseStudies.learning: Automate the part everyone repeats, not the part everyone notices.

kpis.label: use cases deployed across sites & BUs

smart.specific: Remove the deployment bottleneck: give data scientists and engineers a **low-code** way to package any ML model for Siemens Industrial Edge, and to redeploy after every retrain without starting over.
smart.measurable: Cut model-to-deployment time from **90 to 30 days**; **18+ use cases** deployed through AI-X across multiple sites and business units.
smart.achievable: Mapped which parts of the Edge SDK change per model and built a model-agnostic skeleton with a staged **CI/CD pipeline** (Azure ML, GitHub Actions, Power Apps), pytest tests, SonarQube and IT compliance review. Shipped in agile sprints and drove adoption through dedicated enablement sessions of about **20 people each**, run within the WISE Coach Qualification.
smart.relevant: Packaging, not model building, was slowing AI adoption, and every retrain restarted the manual work.
smart.timeBound: First version built during my master thesis (2023–24); production release in **June 2024**, completed in **January 2025**.

caseStudies.name: WISE Coach Qualification (WCQ): turning plant teams into local AI builders
caseStudies.learning: Great technology writes the pilot; empowered local teams write the scale.

smart.specific: Build local AI capability in every region (**North America, Latin America, Asia and Europe**) so plant teams can find, build and own AI use cases instead of relying on one central team.
smart.measurable: **207 people qualified** in 4 sessions last fiscal year, delivering **19 use cases worth $9M**, with ratings **above 4.7 out of 5** in every session. This fiscal year: **10 sessions** planned with at least **20 participants** each.
smart.achievable: Mapped capability across Python, JMP and SmartBox and designed a hands-on qualification in which teams reach MVP and feasibility, then coached them on to PoC and pilot. I lead the program end-to-end.
smart.relevant: Central teams don't scale; local owners do. Every qualified practitioner becomes a builder on their own line.
smart.timeBound: **3 days** to MVP and feasibility within the qualification; **30–90 days** to PoC and pilot.

caseStudies.name: Touchless quality: ending 100% manual inspection on a soldering line
caseStudies.problem: Soldering rejects (~1%) were caught only by 100% manual inspection.
caseStudies.learning: The answer is often already in the process data. Look at when defects happen, not only what they are.
caseStudies.action: Analysed the process data and found that rejects peaked right after maintenance and tracked the soldering pump current. Put a pump-current control strategy in place at start-up and after cleaning.

caseStudyNote: Dollar values and metrics reflect internal business cases and team outcomes across global sites, with my specific role stated on each case. Details are kept at a level that respects confidentiality.

featuredProject.name: Coinfluence
featuredProject.summary: A personal finance dashboard I designed and built for my household. It reads monthly exports from six German banks and brokers and answers three questions: how much did we spend, how much did we save and invest, and who owes whom on the shared card.
features: One upload for every bank: the account is detected and duplicates are skipped
Swipe deck to split shared credit-card charges, with a settle-up checklist
Budgets, recurring-payment detection and net worth over time
Two profiles with separate data and settings

decisions.title: Local-first by design
decisions.text: Financial data never leaves the laptop; sync goes only to a private repo, and the sync script refuses to run on a public one.

decisions.title: Trust over features
decisions.text: Automatic backups before every save, file locking, and damaged files are never overwritten.

decisions.title: Tested without real data
decisions.text: The test suite builds fake statements for every bank, and CI runs it on every push.

featuredProject.note: The source is private because it handles personal financial data. Happy to demo it live.

aboutMe: I was a 90s kid who grew up watching science fiction, fascinated by worlds where technology could do things that seemed impossible. I’ve always loved the idea of what could be—and the curiosity to figure out how to make it happen. Looking back, perhaps it’s no surprise that I found my way into IT, AI, and innovation. Today, I get to bring a little of that futuristic thinking into the real world.

At Procter & Gamble’s Kronberg Innovation Center, I lead the scaling of manufacturing AI across a global plant network—connecting factory-floor challenges with data science, IT, and engineering to turn promising pilots into solutions that work in production.

I’m fascinated by the technology, but even more by what makes innovation stick: solving the right problems, building reusable solutions, bringing cross-functional teams together, and empowering people to carry ideas forward themselves.
Beyond technology, I’m a curious lifelong learner who enjoys teaching, building teams, and turning ambitious goals into tangible results.

I’m a planner with a bias for action. I like turning ideas into plans and plans into progress. But life rarely follows a perfect roadmap. When things don’t go to plan, I adapt, learn, and keep moving. I’m an optimist about detours; sometimes, what feels like a setback leads somewhere even better than we had imagined.

I’m also a strategic thinker who likes to roll up my sleeves and get things done. I enjoy seeing the bigger picture while figuring out the practical steps to make it happen. And I believe the best ideas rarely succeed in isolation—they need people who challenge one another, share knowledge, and bring out the best in each other. For me, that’s where strategy turns into progress: when good ideas meet good people and the willingness to make things happen.
